editorial:
You're dropped into a dark, twisted world where a young girl named Veronica has been raised and trained by a mysterious man named William to become a deadly weapon. When a group of popular senior boys lure her into the woods with plans to make her their next victim, they have no idea what they're walking into. The movie mixes teen drama with survival thriller vibes, creating a tense atmosphere that keeps you guessing. Abigail Breslin delivers a surprisingly fierce performance as Veronica, and the stylish visuals give the film a dreamlike quality. The pacing is steady, building toward a satisfying showdown in the forest.

On the downside, the story can feel a bit thin at times, and some characters lack depth beyond their roles. Still, if you enjoy revenge thrillers with a strong female lead, this one is worth your time. The action scenes are fun, and the final confrontation delivers. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Veronica turns the tables on the boys in the woods. She uses her training to take them down one by one. The twist is that William has been watching from a distance, making sure she can handle herself. Veronica proves she's ready and kills the last boy. She walks away stronger, no longer needing William's protection. The movie ends with her stepping into her own power, having completed her transformation from victim to hunter.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves revenge thrillers with a strong female lead.
